## Truthful gaps

- **Hardware ray tracing:** The RTX 5080 is the review GPU, but the current renderer does not implement hardware ray tracing. No RTX-specific ray-tracing claim or toggle is permitted.
- **Screen-space global illumination:** The experimental upstream node is not exposed until normal/depth, temporal stability, resource disposal and representative-hardware budgets pass.
- **Screen-space reflections:** The experimental upstream node is not exposed without a verified material MRT, occlusion behavior, disposal receipt and performance budget.
- **Depth of field:** First-person weapon depth, focus transitions, target readability and reduced-sensory behavior have not passed the required gates.
- **Motion blur:** The current scene graph has no verified velocity MRT, weapon-layer composition or reduced-motion contract for blur.
- **AI upscaling and frame generation:** Vendor-native DLSS, Ray Reconstruction and frame-generation APIs are not available to this browser renderer and are never simulated by labels.
